email.subject1: a signal play for True Fit
email.body1:
Jane, saw True Fit launched its agentic AI shopping experience and an MCP server built on 20 years of fit data.

A launch like that creates more in-market accounts than reps can act on while the signal is warm, and slow signal-to-action is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, written outreach with zero rep time: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new headcount.

I built a personalized signal play for True Fit off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jane, quick follow-up for True Fit.

From a RevOps seat the real cost is latency: a signal fires, but research, writing, and CRM logging slow the response until the moment is gone. That drag is measurable, and it is fixable without adding reps.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change, and our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70%.
email.body3:
Jane, last bit of proof for True Fit.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how True Fit's reply rate likely compares to other retail-AI teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jane, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A launch quarter is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your RevOps motion? I'll tailor it to True Fit either way.
